grammar.why: Balochi has no grammatical gender for nouns — "kitaab" is neutral.
grammar.urWhy: Balochi nouns do not take gender.

grammar.why: A male speaker says "من ماندہ اِن"; the adjective follows the pronoun.
Balochi is SOV — the verb is last.
grammar.urWhy: The verb comes at the end.

grammar.why: Adjectives precede the noun: مزن گس.
Direct object needs no postposition: نان وارین.
grammar.urWhy: The direct object takes no marker.

stories.title: کوئٹہ ئہ پہلمین سفر
stories.text:
کریم صبح کوئٹہ رسیت.
اہو ٹیکسیئں ___ (1) تہ روت.
کمرهێں اهو ___ (2) آشمت.
پس اهو منی ___ (3) تا زنګ کرت.
stories.en: Karim reaches Quetta in the morning. He goes by taxi to the hotel. In the room he drinks tea. Then he calls his family.

stories.title: بازارێں خرید
stories.text:
سمیہ جمعہ روچ ___ (1) روت.
اوه نان، دود ۏ ___ (2) گریت.
ادائگی اوه ___ (3) ئں کرت.
stories.en: Sameea goes shopping on Friday. She buys bread, milk and apples. She pays by card.

stories.title: گم بوتگین پاسپورٹ
stories.text:
احمد پنیں ___ (1) گردایت.
اہو یک ___ (2) ئں داتار پرسیت.
شپاش اوه پنیں ___ (3) ئں درکورت.
stories.en: Ahmad is looking for his passport. He asks a policeman for help. Luckily it is found in his bag.

stories.title: ڈاکٹر ئاں
stories.text:

اہو ___ (2) ئاں روت.
ڈاکٹر اهو دوا ۏ ___ (3) دات.
stories.en: Bilal is unwell. He goes to the doctor. The doctor gives him medicine and rest.

stories.title: بلۏچی جماعت
stories.text:
نادیہ سہ ماہ بوتگ ___ (1) یاد گیریت.
اوه ہر شام ___ (2) ئں مشق کنت.
اوهئیں ___ (3) آوژنت اوه باش آوژیت.
stories.en: Nadia has been learning Balochi for three months. She practises every evening with books. Her teacher says she speaks well.

stories.title: ٹبرێں ناں
stories.text:
جمعہ روچ پچیں ___ (1) آت.
نانه ___ (2) پز کرت.
پچ یکرہ ناشته ۏ ډیر ___ (3) کرت.
stories.en: On Friday the whole family comes. The grandmother cooks rice. Everyone eats together and laughs a lot.

stories.title: اسٹیشنێں

حسن دکان ئں ___ (2) گریت.
پس اهو ___ (3) ئں نشست.
stories.en: The train is ten minutes late. Hassan buys a newspaper. Then he sits in the train.

stories.title: زمستانێں شپ

اوه گرمین ___ (3) آشمت ۏ کتاب وانگ بوت.
stories.en: In January it is very cold. Aisha wears a warm coat. She drinks hot tea and reads.

stories.title: ہوٹلێں ناں
stories.text:
خادم ___ (1) آورت.
عمر ماہی ۏ ___ (2) لوٹ کرت.
آخرێں اهو ___ (3) لوٹ کرت.
stories.en: The waiter brings the menu. Omar orders fish and rice. At the end he asks for the bill.

stories.title: نۆکین رفق
stories.text:
لینا ۏ ثنا ___ (1) ئں ملنت.
اوہاں موسیقی ۏ ___ (2) باروا آوژنت.

stories.en: Lena and Sana meet in the park. They talk about music and travel. At the end they exchange their numbers.
